notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other planeswalkers.
Rowan's Talent attached to Teferi.
Teferi has an amount of loyalty counters on it equal to or greater than eleven minus the number of other planeswalkers you control.
description:
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter to Teferi.
Repeat step 1 for each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Rowan's Talent triggers, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve both Teferi abilities, causing you to take four extra turns after this one.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Teferi by putting zero loyalty counters on it.
Rowan's Talent triggers, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve both Teferi abilities, causing you to put two loyalty counters on it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2.
Repeat from step 6 two additional times.
Move to your final extra turn.
Repeat from step 1.
